scenes.subtitle: A three-scene audio test
scenes.narration: Welcome to a short test video about how vaccines teach your body to defend itself.

scenes.title: The process
scenes.narration: A vaccine shows your immune system a harmless piece of a virus, which starts a response and builds protective antibodies.

scenes.title: Key takeaways
scenes.narration: So vaccines train your immune system safely, and they help protect the whole community around you.
